results.title: JNIM Claims IED Attack on Malian Army and Africa Corps Vehicle Between Sévaré and Konna
results.snippet: Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), al-Qaeda's Sahel affiliate, says it targeted a vehicle carrying Malian army and Russian Africa Corps personnel with an improvised explosive device on the morning of Monday, 2 November 2026.
